about_the_game:
With societal developments and technologic advancement, visualization and virtual reality are becoming a greater and greater part of people's work and life. As its foundation, 3D simulation is rapidly changing from a technology that only some professionals can master to a basic skill that is popular among the general public. In reality, softwares supporting this technology usually have problems such as huge volume, complicated functions, low integration, high price, steep learning curve and poor comprehensive performance, which make them unable to meet needs for and affect the popularity of this technology.

Houseplan is a 3D drawing and simulation software designed by senior design professionals, with professional and flexible modeling functions and an efficient rendering engine to achieve dynamic simulation with simultaneous drawing and rendering. With a small volume, high integration, excellent cost performance, the practical, easy-to-use, and efficient Houseplan can be widely applied to architectural and scene design, and can be used with virtual reality and metaverse. It is a user-friendly 3D software, suitable for individuals and organizations with any kind of background.

Houseplan offers the most efficient 3D modeling for building planning, helping you complete your scheme design quickly and easily with just a few clicks.

Houseplan offers advanced 3D modeling tools to satisfy diverse and complicated modeling requirements. It's simpler, lighter, and easier to use than other large and complex software on the market.

Houseplan uses a high-performance rendering engine to sync 3D model editing with simulations, providing interactive and responsive environments that display rendered results instantly.

With Houseplan, you can not only gain the power to effortlessly apply and fine-tune materials, but also seamlessly import a diverse array of materials from a wide range of sources, whether you're handling them individually or in bulk.

With Houseplan, you can easily import DWG drawings and directly extrude them. Additionally, it supports importing of oblique photography and point cloud data, as well as various other file formats.

Houseplan enables convenient addition of water, vegetation, terrain, and other scene elements, and provides the ability to exchange realistic weather environments. Moreover, you can easily add animation entities and set their movements.

Houseplan provides tools for specifying camera points and video paths, allowing users to export images and videos. It also supports VR device viewing. Additionally, users can publish their designs as .exe files for independent operation, enabling image and video viewing, drawing new video paths, displaying properties, and switching weather environments.
